walkthrough: Goal: the chrome feels finished and organic: whatever comes and goes shows where it comes from and where it goes, and nothing I do ever waits for it.
Entry: open OpenPaint on the tablet (2880 x 1800, landscape) on an empty library and ink a line with the pen.

Panels: tap Brush. The ink ring around it draws in, and the brush panel grows out of that ring, sharing one ink outline with the right island while it pours down under it; its rows fade in only as it finishes (about 0.4 s). Tap Layers: the brush panel retracts into its own button at once and the layer panel grows out of the Layers button a moment later, finishing last. Tap + : the new layer's row appears at the top and the rows below slide down to make room. Tap the canvas outside: the panel goes back into its button faster than it came, and a pen stroke started at once where the panel was still shrinking draws there.
Never waiting: tap Brush and, before the panel has grown, tap Pencil where its row will be: Pencil is chosen. Draw at once: the stroke appears under the pen from its first sample; the panel closes.
Acknowledge: the ink ring of a button that turns on or off draws in or fades where it is; the Reference switch's knob slides across and inks in; the current colour's swatch mark does the same.
Selection: tap the lasso: its bar grows out of the button into the top band's middle; tap it again: the bar goes back into the button.

View: spread two fingers to zoom in, then quickly pinch: the canvas glides back to fit instead of jumping, and a pen landing during the glide stops it where the view already is. Navigation itself (pan, zoom, rotate) follows the fingers exactly, with no motion of its own.
Eyedropper: tap it, touch the canvas: the loupe grows out of the finger; lift: it goes back into where the finger was, and the colour is taken.

Reference and notices: Actions grows out of the spanner. Turn Reference on and choose a picture: the reference window grows out of the Actions button; close it with x: it goes back into that button. Save a PNG: the 'Saving PNG' and 'Saved' pill grows out of its right end beside the right island.

Gallery: tap Gallery: the canvas shrinks into its card in the gallery. Tap the card's bin: the delete dialog grows out of the card as the screen darkens; Back: it goes back into the card. Tap the card: the canvas grows out of the card's picture into its fit and draws at once.

Failure and cancel: interrupting any motion (another tap, a new panel, a stroke) retargets it from where it is; nothing queues and no tap is ever lost or delayed. Undo, strokes, slider drags, the ColorDrop dot and the hover outline never move on their own. After a restart nothing is moving.
